```python
def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

# one task's program: the one shape, cut out by dropping every one-color row and column, mirrored left to right
from lib import compress
def transform(grid):
    return [row[::-1] for row in compress(grid)]

# another's: every cell as a block whose side is the number of colors other than the background
from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):
    return upscale(grid, len({v for row in grid for v in row}) - 1)
```

def trailing_run(row,bg):
    last=max((c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg), default=-1)
    if last<0: return 0,-1
    l=0; c=last
    while c>=0 and row[c]!=bg: l+=1; c-=1
    return l,last
for k in [2,3]:

        bad=[]
        for r,row in enumerate(a):
            l,last=trailing_run(row,bg)
            d=[c for c in range(w) if b[r][c]!=row[c]]
            fill_expected = last>=0 and last<w-1 and l>=k
            got_fill = bool(d)
            # expected diff = last+1..w-1
            ok = (d==list(range(last+1,w))) if got_fill else (last<0 or last==w-1 or l<k)
            if not ok: bad.append((r,l,last,d))
        print(i,'ok' if not bad else bad[:4])

def bands(a,bg):
    has=[any(v!=bg for v in row) for row in a]
    out=[];cur=[]
    for r,h in enumerate(has):

def simulate(a, mode, toedge):

def trailing_run_row(a,r,bg):
    t=max((c for c,v in enumerate(a[r]) if v!=bg), default=-1)
    if t<0: return t,set(),0
    L=0
    while t-L>=0 and a[r][t-L]!=bg: L+=1
    return t,set(range(t-L+1,t+1)),L

def simulate4(a):
    H=len(a);W=len(a[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in a]
    bs=bands(a,bg)
    band_of={r:bi for bi,b in enumerate(bs) for r in b}
    rel={r:k for bi,b in enumerate(bs) for k,r in enumerate(b)}
    tip={};run={}
    for r in range(H):
        t,rs,L=trailing_run_row(a,r,bg)
        tip[r]=t; run[r]=rs
    body={r:{c for c,v in enumerate(a[r]) if v!=bg} for r in range(H)}
    rows_with=[r for r in range(H) if tip[r]>=0]
    maxtip=max(tip[r] for r in rows_with) if rows_with else -1
    for r in rows_with:
        bi=band_of[r]; cur=body[r]
        # BELOW refs: any best shift
        for j in range(bi+1,len(bs)):
            if rel[r]>=len(bs[j]): continue
            ref=bs[j][rel[r]]
            if tip[ref]<0: continue
            Bj=body[ref]
            best=max(range(-6,7), key=lambda s:(len({c for c in cur if c+s in Bj}), -s))
            ov=len({c for c in cur if c+best in Bj})
            if ov < len(cur)-1: continue
            for p in Bj:
                c=p-best
                if c>tip[r] and c<=maxtip and c not in cur:
                    out[r][c]=1
        # ABOVE refs: require zero shift best, contiguous ext within ref trailing run
        for j in range(bi):
            if rel[r]>=len(bs[j]): continue
            ref=bs[j][rel[r]]
            if tip[ref]<0: continue
            Bj=body[ref]
            ovs={s:len({c for c in cur if c+s in Bj}) for s in range(-6,7)}
            best=max(range(-6,7), key=lambda s:(ovs[s],-s))
            if best!=0 or ovs[0] < len(cur)-1: continue
            if len(run[ref])<2: continue
            c=tip[r]+1
            while c<=maxtip and c in Bj and c in run[ref]:
                out[r][c]=1; c+=1
    return out

def simulate6(a):
    H=len(a);W=len(a[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in a]
    bs=bands(a,bg)
    band_of={r_:bi for bi,b in enumerate(bs) for r_ in b}
    rel={r_:k for bi,b in enumerate(bs) for k,r_ in enumerate(b)}
    tip={};run={}
    for r_ in range(H):
        t,rs,L=trow(a,r_,bg); tip[r_]=t; run[r_]=rs
    body={r_:{c for c,v in enumerate(a[r_]) if v!=bg} for r_ in range(H)}
    rows_with=[r_ for r_ in range(H) if tip[r_]>=0]
    maxtip=max(tip[r_] for r_ in rows_with) if rows_with else -1
    for r_ in rows_with:
        bi=band_of[r_]; cur=body[r_]
        for j in range(bi+1,len(bs)):      # BELOW refs
            if rel[r_]>=len(bs[j]): continue
            ref=bs[j][rel[r_]]
            if tip[ref]<0: continue
            Bj=body[ref]
            ovs={s:len({c for c in cur if c+s in Bj}) for s in range(-6,7)}
            best=max(range(-6,7), key=lambda s:(ovs[s],-s))
            if ovs[best] < len(cur)-2: continue
            for p in Bj:
                c=p-best
                if c>tip[r_] and c<=maxtip and c not in cur: out[r_][c]=1
        for j in range(bi):                # ABOVE refs: contiguous extension within ref's trailing run
            if rel[r_]>=len(bs[j]): continue
            ref=bs[j][rel[r_]]
            if tip[ref]<0: continue
            Bj=body[ref]
            ovs={s:len({c for c in cur if c+s in Bj}) for s in range(-6,7)}
            best=max(range(-6,7), key=lambda s:(ovs[s],-s))
            if ovs[best] < len(cur)-1: continue
            if len(run[ref])<2: continue
            cand=sorted(p-best for p in Bj if p-best>tip[r_] and p-best<=maxtip and (p-best) not in cur and (p-best) in run[ref])
            if cand and cand[0]==tip[r_]+1 and cand==list(range(tip[r_]+1,tip[r_]+1+len(cand))):
                for c in cand: out[r_][c]=1
    return out

def features(pp,i):
    W_=len(pp['input'][0])
    bg_=Counter(v for row in pp['input'] for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    a_=pp['input']; o_=pp['output']
    Bd={r_:{c for c,v in enumerate(a_[r_]) if v!=bg_} for r_ in range(len(a_)) if any(v!=bg_ for v in a_[r_])}
    tip={r_:max(Bd[r_]) for r_ in Bd}
    mt=max(tip.values())
    bs_=bands(a_,bg_); rel_={r_:k for b_,b in enumerate(bs_) for k,r_ in enumerate(b)}
    out=[]
    for r_ in Bd:
        fill=[c for c in range(W_) if o_[r_][c]==1 and a_[r_][c]!=1]
        if not fill: continue
        bi=[b_ for b_,b in enumerate(bs_) if r_ in b][0]; k=bs_[bi].index(r_)
        ref=None
        for jb in ([1-bi] if len(bs_)==2 else [x for x in range(len(bs_)) if x!=bi]):
            if k<len(bs_[jb]): ref=bs_[jb][k]; break
        # true sigma: offsets p-c for p in ref markers, c in fill
        offs=Counter(p_-c for p_ in Bd[ref] for c in fill)
        sig=offs.most_common()
        # sigma0: ref markers beyond tip
        s0=sorted(c for c in Bd[ref] if c>tip[r_] and c<=mt)
        # own continuation: period = last gap
        m=sorted(Bd[r_])
        g=m[-1]-m[-2] if len(m)>1 else 0
        own=[]; c=tip[r_]
        while True:
            c+=g
            if c>mt: break
            own.append(c)
        solid = (g==1)
        out.append((i,r_,bi,k,ref,tip[r_],tip[ref],mt,fill,'sigtop',sig[:3],'s0match',sorted(fill)==s0,'own',own,'ownmatch',sorted(fill)==sorted(own) if own else None,'g',g))
    return out
for i in range(18):
    for f in features(pairs2[i],i): print(f)

```python
def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]
```

code = '''

def periodic_wave_fill(grid, fill=1, bg=None, marker=None):
    """Fill bg cells whose vertically-periodic (period T, drift s) partner holds a marker."""
    from collections import Counter
    if bg is None:
        bg = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    if marker is None:
        marker = next(c for c in {v for r in grid for v in r} if c != bg)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    M = {(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] == marker}
    best = None
    for T in range(1, h):
        for s in range(-w + 1, w):
            good = bad = 0
            for (i, j) in M:
                i2, j2 = i - T, j - s
                if 0 <= i2 < h and 0 <= j2 < w:
                    if (i2, j2) in M:
                        good += 1
                    else:
                        bad += 1
            if good and (best is None or good - 3 * bad > best[0]):
                best = (good - 3 * bad, T, s)
    if best is None:
        return [r[:] for r in grid]
    _, T, s = best
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] != bg:
                continue
            for (i2, j2) in ((i - T, j - s), (i + T, j + s)):
                if 0 <= i2 < h and 0 <= j2 < w and (i2, j2) in M:
                    out[i][j] = fill
                    break
    return out
'''
